title: A GABAergic preoptic-raphe circuit mediates paradoxical coupling of anxiety and social preference after comparative social deficit
title_zh: GABA能前下丘-黑质回路介导比较社会缺失后焦虑与社会偏好矛盾耦合
abstract: Social disconnection is a major risk factor for anxiety disorders, the most prevalent mental illnesses worldwide, yet its neural substrates remain unclear. Here, we establish a comparative social deficit (CSD) model in adult male mice that induces a paradoxical phenotype of increased anxiety-like behavior together with heightened social preference, a pattern conceptually similar to human loneliness. Mechanistically, CSD increases the excitability of medial preoptic GABAergic (mPOAGad2) neurons, which bidirectionally regulate CSD-induced behavioral changes. Transcriptomic and electrophysiological analyses identify downregulation of the Kv4.3 potassium channel (Kcnd3) as a molecular driver of mPOAGad2 hyperexcitability. Furthermore, mPOAGad2 neurons exert monosynaptic inhibition onto dorsal raphe serotonergic (DRN5-HT) neurons. This inhibitory projection, strengthened by CSD, mediates CSD-induced behavioral effects. These findings define a molecular and circuit mechanism by which social disconnection remodels mPOA-DRN interactions to drive the paradoxical coupling of anxiety and elevated social preference, providing a translational framework for understanding loneliness-related psychiatric vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 社会脱节是焦虑障碍——全球最常见精神疾病——的主要风险因素，但其神经基础尚不清楚。我们在成年雄性小鼠中建立了比较社会缺失（CSD）模型，诱导出焦虑行为增加且社会偏好增强的矛盾表型，概念上类似人类孤独。机制上，CSD提升了中下丘GABA能（mPOAGad2）神经元的兴奋性，双向调节CSD诱导的行为变化。转录组和电生理分析发现，Kv4.3钾通道（Kcnd3）下调是mPOAGad2过度兴奋的分子驱动因素。此外，mPOAGad2神经元对背侧黑质5-羟色胺（DRN5-HT）神经元施加单突触抑制。CSD强化了这一抑制投射，介导CSD诱导的行为效应。这些发现阐明了社会脱节如何重塑mPOA-DRN相互作用，驱动焦虑与社会偏好升高的矛盾耦合，为理解孤独相关精神易感性提供了可转化的框架。
